_comment: Cards that exist only for the copy-spell-with-an-exception test (tests/unit/copies/test_copy_spell_except.py). Never part of a deck list. `t_wing_herald` is Donal, Herald of Wings' copy trigger on a vanilla body, without the once-each-turn limit.

cards.name: Test Wing Herald
cards.oracle_text: Whenever you cast a nonlegendary creature spell with flying, you may copy it, except the copy is a 1/1 Spirit in addition to its other types. (A copy of a permanent spell becomes a token.)

abilities.text: Whenever you cast a nonlegendary creature spell with flying, you may copy it, except the copy is a 1/1 Spirit in addition to its other types.
